findings.consequence: At the owner checkpoint, a running workload can continue its paid execution while the watchdog polls the original job-run LRO instead of cancelling it. A local paused ledger does not stop the expensive operation.
findings.likelihood: Normal accepted run.job operation may be pending when the forecast reaches100 or heartbeat fails.
findings.evidence: Synthetic forecast100/fresh heartbeat/pending run LRO produced only operation GET+alert and provider-operation-pending, no cancel POST.
findings.smallestRequiredCorrection: Prioritize exact owned active job cancellation over waiting for original job-run completion. Persist cancellation and reconcile asynchronously; keep original operation evidence without letting it gate the stop request. Test100 checkpoint with running LRO, lost run reply, cancellation pending/failure and replacement execution.

findings.consequence: After a lost SQL stop response, configured activation policy is labeled stopped without any completion evidence. Owner handoff could misstate whether compute costs have stopped.
findings.likelihood: Directly reachable response-loss path already supported by provider transport.
findings.evidence: First stop PATCH raised unknown outcome; next tick saw NEVER and returned sql-stopped-storage-charges-remain without operation poll/completion.
findings.smallestRequiredCorrection: Persist stop intent and separate stop-requested/configured from confirmed completion. Reconcile known or lost operations boundedly; unknown remains unresolved and alerts. Never turn activation configuration alone into verified compute-stop evidence. Test lost stop reply, pending stop, denied poll and actual completed stop; retain storage liability.

findings.consequence: An owner policy declaration alone enables SQL DELETE despite the task requiring independently established exclusivity and single-use names. SQL has no atomic incarnation precondition, so these proof conditions matter.
findings.likelihood: Current deterministic positive test supplies only four booleans/reference; no independent eligibility record.
findings.evidence: Direct adapter call with signed-policy-shaped flags and exact resource receipt sent DELETE with zero separate proof.
findings.smallestRequiredCorrection: Require explicit independently reviewed eligibility evidence tied to the exact approved project/run/resource plan and immutable original clock, with applicable freshness/revocation and single-use name conditions. Existing exact incarnation and policy checks remain. Without proven conditions, stop and require supervised deletion. Local tests certify refusal/binding logic only; effective real IAM and exclusive window remain future supervised gate evidence.
